name: tapfiliate
label: Tapfiliate
description: Affiliate tracking and conversion management platform.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To obtain your API key:

1. Log in to your Tapfiliate account.
2. Open your account settings.
3. Find the API key section.
4. Copy the API key and paste it here.

create_affiliate.label: Create Affiliate
create_affiliate.description: Creates a new affiliate in Tapfiliate.

password.label: Password
password.description: Password for the new affiliate account.

countryCode.label: Country Code
countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US or NL.

get_affiliate.label: Get Affiliate
get_affiliate.description: Retrieves a Tapfiliate affiliate by ID.

affiliateId.label: Affiliate ID
affiliateId.description: The unique Tapfiliate affiliate ID. Find it on the affiliate detail page in your Tapfiliate dashboard.

create_conversion.label: Create Conversion
create_conversion.description: Creates a conversion in Tapfiliate. At least one attribution field is required: Customer ID, Referral Code, Tracking ID, Click ID, Coupon, or Asset ID + Source ID together.

referralCode.label: Referral Code
referralCode.description: The affiliate's referral code used to attribute this conversion.

trackingId.label: Tracking ID
trackingId.description: The Tapfiliate tracking ID stored in the affiliate click cookie.

clickId.label: Click ID
clickId.description: The Tapfiliate click ID from the affiliate referral link.

coupon.label: Coupon
coupon.description: A coupon code linked to an affiliate to attribute this conversion.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code such as USD or EUR.

assetId.label: Asset ID
assetId.description: The Tapfiliate asset ID. Must be provided together with Source ID.

sourceId.label: Source ID
sourceId.description: The Tapfiliate source ID. Must be provided together with Asset ID.

externalId.label: External ID
externalId.description: Your own unique identifier for this conversion, such as an order number.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Conversion amount used to calculate commissions.

customerId.label: Customer ID
customerId.description: Your customer identifier to attribute this conversion to the matching affiliate.

overrideMaxCookieTime.label: Override Max Cookie Time
overrideMaxCookieTime.description: Override the maximum cookie time for this conversion.
